title: How is Stalin connected to Optimus Prime?
description: Seven links connect Joseph Stalin to Optimus Prime, through Mao, two presidents, two movie stars and the voice of the Autobots.
hook: How is Joseph Stalin connected to Optimus Prime?

links.line: In December 1949, Mao Zedong came to Moscow for Stalin's seventieth birthday.

image.file: File:President Gerald Ford and Daughter Susan Watch as Secretary of State Henry Kissinger Shakes Hands with Mao Tse-Tung.jpg

links.line: In 1975, President Gerald Ford flew to Beijing and met Mao, a year before Mao died.

image.file: File:Gerald Ford with George H. W. Bush.jpg

links.line: Ford and George H. W. Bush were old friends, and in 1976 Ford made Bush director of the CIA.

image.file: File:President George H. W. Bush and Robert Redford.jpg

links.line: In 1989, President Bush welcomed movie star Robert Redford to the Oval Office.

image.file: File:Redford e LaBeouf - 69th Venice International Film Festival.jpg

links.line: In 2012, Redford premiered his film The Company You Keep in Venice with co-star Shia LaBeouf.
In 2025, Shia LaBeouf, star of Transformers, reunited with Peter Cullen at Steel City Con.

pair.file: File:Transformers - The Ride at Universal Studios Singapore, 20240206 1247 6415.jpg

links.line: And Optimus Prime is voiced by Peter Cullen, who played him for over forty years.
